version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This Google Docs skill is coherent and disclosed, but it relies on an external ClawLink plugin and OAuth-backed access to read and modify documents.

dimensions.detail: Managed OAuth and Google account document access are proportionate for a Google Docs integration, but document content and exports can be sensitive and should be limited to accounts and documents the user intends to expose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires adding the ClawLink plugin to OpenClaw's allowlist and restarting the gateway. The artifact does not pin a plugin version or provide a checksum, so users depend on the ClawHub package and ClawLink verification process.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions direct agents to verify live tool catalogs, preview or describe unfamiliar/write operations, and require explicit user confirmation before create, update, or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden persistence, background worker, or bundled executable payload was found. The plugin allowlist entry and connected OAuth authorization persist until the user removes or revokes them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated Google Docs purpose matches the documented search, read, create, update, export, copy, and deletion capabilities. The linked Google Sheets chart listing is adjacent cross-product access, but it is explicitly listed as read-only.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using ClawLink as the managed OAuth bridge for Google Docs. Review the plugin source or verification page where available, use the least-privileged Google account suitable for the task, confirm all writes carefully, and revoke the Google authorization or remove the plugin allowlist entry when no longer needed.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Drive-backed discovery and stable Drive file IDs are expected for Google Docs documents, and the artifact discloses that documents are stored in Google Drive.
[SDI-1] expected: The spreadsheet-chart tool is cross-product and worth noticing, but it is disclosed in the tool table as read-only and fits linked-chart document workflows.
[T08] expected: Installing and allowlisting ClawLink is expected for this hosted integration, but the artifact lacks an immutable version or digest, making it a supply-chain trust consideration rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
